description: Send the guest's booking request for one villa and stay to the Virgo Villas Barbados team, in the guest's name, as the site's booking form does: the team replies to the guest's email, and the guest gets a copy. No sign-in needed: give the guest's email, and the site's spam filter checks the request, as it checks the form. (With a sign-in the guest approved, scope booking:request, the email they approved is used and no spam check is needed; see https://www.virgovillasbarbados.com/auth.md.) Use it only when the guest has asked to go ahead with exactly these details and has accepted the Booking Conditions (https://www.virgovillasbarbados.com/terms-conditions.html). It is a request, not a booking: the team checks availability and the exact price with the villa, and nothing is booked or paid until they confirm. Booked dates and stays under the minimum are refused rather than sent. One request per villa and stay: asking again returns the first answer.

accept_booking_conditions.description: true only when the guest has read the Booking Conditions (https://www.virgovillasbarbados.com/terms-conditions.html) and accepted them.

assistant_name.description: Your name as the guest knows you (for example ChatGPT or Claude), shown to the team with the request.

departure.description: Departure date as YYYY-MM-DD, the morning the guests leave.

email.description: The guest's email address: the team replies to it and the guest's copy goes there. Required unless you are signed in with the guest's approval.

notes.description: Anything else the guest wants the team to know (no links).

phone.description: The lead guest's phone number, with the country code.

villa.description: The villa's slug, name or numeric id.

name: request_booking
title: Send the guest's booking request
